resources.string:
If tapping a tile does nothing, Shizuku has usually been killed by the system: tap "Open Shizuku" and start the service from there.

If this app itself has not been authorized, tap "Request authorization"; if that fails, enable this app manually under "Authorized applications" in Shizuku.

"Allow background running" adds this app to the battery optimization whitelist, which reduces the chance of the tiles going dead after the system cleans up background processes.
Shizuku: running, but not yet authorized for this app

The device will not come back on by itself. If the power button is already broken, you may need to plug in the charger, hold a volume key combination, or even short contacts on the board to boot again. Power off anyway?
Authorized, the tiles are ready to use
Not authorized, the tiles cannot run commands
Shizuku is not running, open it and start the service first
Shizuku is not installed on this device
Already on the battery optimization ignore list
Could not open settings, allow background running manually under Battery -> App power management
